summary: Iteration 68 - CC2026 Point 4 (Studios Sidebar) and Point 7 (Immersive Inbox) Testing. Both new features are working correctly. Studios Sidebar slides from left with 4 studios (LinkedIn, Feed & Reel, Shop, Preview & Terminal), each expandable with tools. Immersive Inbox shows Instagram DM-style interface with 7 ghost conversations for proof of life. All existing features (Feed, Reels, Wallet, Shop, Profile) remain functional.

minor.issue: 429 Too Many Requests errors in console (rate limiting)

ui_bugs.issue: CVL BRAIN floating button (z-[90]) intercepts clicks on Immersive Inbox send button (z-[70]). The floating button overlays the inbox when both are visible.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Either hide CvlBrainFloat when ImmersiveInbox is open, or increase ImmersiveInbox z-index to z-[95]
